arrivalProcess.$comment: Passengers arrive in groups, not singly. Batch size materially changes loading and stop patterns.

profiles.name: Residential
profiles.$comment: PM inverts to up-peak. Larger batches: families travel together.

demandTemplates.name: CIBSE rise-and-fall template
demandTemplates.shape: ramp up to peak, hold, ramp down
demandTemplates.$comment: Use this. Each replication generates an independent passenger set, satisfying the independence condition required for confidence intervals.

demandTemplates.name: ISO 8100-32 constant demand
demandTemplates.$comment: Single long run. Incompatible with confidence intervals across replications because waiting times within one run are correlated. Supported for cross-checking only.

passengerMass.$comment: Drives the load sensor. Must be a distribution, not a constant, or the load sensor has nothing to measure.
